linesEn: Curse it!
We're a step too late after all!

linesZhTw: 都已經先撤走了，只剩下一
些戰士還在抵擋獸人的攻勢
linesZhCn: 都已经先撤走了，只剩下一
些战士还在抵挡兽人的攻势
linesEn: Don't worry. It looks like the villagers have already evacuated.
Only a few warriors remain, struggling to hold off the orc assault...
...We have to help them!
Splendid! The treasure chests appear untouched.
I wonder if the Eye of Flame is...
What was that?
...N-Nothing! Nothing at all!
Come, let's hurry and help them!
Right! Let's route those orcs and send them packing!
Charge!
Great heavens!
What in blazes is going on here?
F-Father!
What are you doing here?

linesZhTw: 我只是來看個老朋友而已…
linesZhCn: 我只是来看个老朋友而已…
linesEn: What, can't an old dwarf drop by?
I only came to visit an old friend... How did everything turn into such a mess?

linesZhTw: 村內的居民好像都逃光了，
linesZhCn: 村内的居民好像都逃光了，
linesEn: An orc army attacked us!
The villagers seem to have fled, and we're engaging the enemy right now...

linesZhTw: 這些傢伙是活的不耐煩了？
我先來給牠們幾斧頭再說！
linesZhCn: 这些家伙是活的不耐烦了？
我先来给它们几斧头再说！
linesEn: Orcs?! Do those vermin have a death wish?
I'll give 'em a taste of my axe first!
Keep up with your old man, boy!
Right behind you, Father!
Old man Havart, glad to have you with us!

linesZhTw: 以後你要自己照顧自己了，
linesZhCn: 以后你要自己照顾自己了，
linesEn: ...Ugh, I'm too old for this after all. Pushed myself too hard...
Harno, you'll have to look after yourself from now on...
Your father... can go no further...
Aaargh...!
You can never wipe out the elves...
Aaargh!
Gaaah...!
Aaargh...!
Gaaah...!
Raaargh! Slaughter them all...!

linesZhTw: 還有好久不見的哈瓦那老爹
幸好你們帶了幫手來，要不
linesZhCn: 还有好久不见的哈瓦那老爹
幸好你们带了帮手来，要不
linesEn: Aren't you Beckway and Shan?
And old man Havart—it's been so long!
Thank goodness you brought reinforcements, or else...

linesZhTw: 然我們真會抵擋不住了。』
linesZhCn: 然我们真会抵挡不住了。』
linesEn: ...we would have been overwhelmed!
Still, how did you know the orc army was attacking?

linesZhTw: 還好這些朋友願意幫忙。
linesZhCn: 还好这些朋友愿意帮忙。
linesEn: Just sheer coincidence!
Thankfully our friends here stepped in to help.
Where are the villagers?

linesZhTw: 居民都連夜撤到安全的地方
linesZhCn: 居民都连夜撤到安全的地方
linesEn: We were warned beforehand,
so the residents evacuated to safety under cover of night.

linesZhTw: 不過聽說獸人大軍還在離哈
斯米爾不遠的蘭迪平原駐固
linesZhCn: 不过听说兽人大军还在离哈
斯米尔不远的兰迪平原驻固
linesEn: However, an orc legion is still encamped on the Randy Plains near Hasmir.
The danger is far from over...

linesZhTw: 哈斯米爾？我到現在還是不
linesZhCn: 哈斯米尔？我到现在还是不
linesEn: Come to think of it, why would the orcs attack Hasmir?
I still can't make any sense of it.

linesZhTw: 牠們在開戰前曾大聲宣言，
要把精靈族殺戮殆盡，為何
linesZhCn: 它们在开战前曾大声宣言，
要把精灵族杀戮殆尽，为何
linesEn: We don't know either.
Before attacking, they bellowed threats to wipe out every last elf.
As for their reasons...
...we haven't the slightest idea.

linesZhTw: 是駐固在那個什麼平原嗎？
我們去把他們殺個人仰馬翻
linesZhCn: 是驻固在那个什么平原吗？
我们去把他们杀个人仰马翻
linesEn: Simple enough!
Aren't the orcs camped out on that plain right now?
We'll storm their camp, smash their lines...
...and squeeze some answers out of the survivors!
Classic Thor...
Though I must admit, it's not a bad plan.

linesZhTw: 那裡太危險了，先把牠們在
野外殲滅，免得牠們又來進
linesZhCn: 那里太危险了，先把它们在
野外歼灭，免得它们又来进
linesEn: Indeed. Leaving those orcs out there is too dangerous.
We should eliminate them in the field before they can launch another strike.
...We must put an end to this threat.

linesZhTw: 我們的戰力大增，要對付
那些獸人相信不是難事。
linesZhCn: 我们的战力大增，要对付
那些兽人相信不是难事。
linesEn: With Havart joining us, our strength has grown significantly.
Handling those orcs shouldn't be a problem.

linesZhTw: 老爹，你會和我們一起去吧
linesZhCn: 老爹，你会和我们一起去吧
linesEn: You'll come with us, won't you, Havart?

linesZhTw: 我也想看看這些日子以來，
linesZhCn: 我也想看看这些日子以来，
linesEn: Of course! A few measly orcs aren't enough to satisfy my blade!
Besides, I want to see how much my boy has improved lately.
Let's see what you've learned, Harno!
Bwahaha!
Then it's settled!
Let's catch our breath and head out!
Damn it! The elves have all been wiped out!
Well done, young warriors!
To display such prowess at your age is truly remarkable.

linesZhTw: 這件重要的寶物絕不能讓它
linesZhCn: 这件重要的宝物绝不能让它
linesEn: This precious relic must never fall into the hands of the orcs.
I entrust it to your care...
Understood! But what is it...?

linesZhTw: 代替我好好的使用它吧！』
linesZhCn: 代替我好好的使用它吧！』
linesEn: Its true purpose will reveal itself in time.
Use it well in my stead!
